reviews.review: have been playing this for a few days, and what can I say, it scratches every itch a zombie horde shooter gamer would want. I don't get the hate, though its probably more of how the game was marketed as the spiritual successor to L4D. While it is, this game stands on its own in every way. Graphics are great, gunplay is great, mobs / enemy types / modifiers mean almost every run is unique in some way, the difficulty steps up and down dynamically or via customisation. Would've been nice if the dev's let us mod this cause damn this would be an awesome playground for mods. All in all, 10/10 as a zombie shooter. Worth it in every regard.
